description: Submit a quotation request for one or more products and get a reference back. It creates an enquiry for a person to price and nothing else: it accepts no price, confirms no stock, commits no delivery date and creates no order. Every part number is validated against the catalogue and the information a quotation still needs is named back in the response. consent must be true, confirming the buyer agreed to their contact details being sent, because the agent calling this is not the buyer.

consent.description: Must be true. Confirms the buyer agreed to their company and contact details being sent to Fortitude21

delivery_destination.description: Port or city the goods ship to

email.description: Business email address for the reply

incoterms.description: Preferred Incoterm, e.g. FOB, CIF, DDP

sku.description: An F21 part number or product slug

specification.description: Colour, branding, closure, gauge, anything specified

notes.description: Anything else the quotation should account for

source.description: The agent or integration sending this, for the enquiry log

name: create_quote_request
title: Send a Fortitude21 quotation request
